name: Time Machine
description:
Time Machine is an AI-powered corporate learning platform for sales enablement, onboarding, and L&D teams.
  Connect Time Machine to Claude to:
   - Browse and author courses, modules, topics, lessons, and exercises                                                                                                 
   - Create AI-generated role-play voice and video exercises for practice
   - Manage users, departments, roles, and demo trainings
   - Query persona-based AI experts grounded in your company's documents
   - Track student progress with insights, learning-byte completion, and certificates 119 operations run against your company's data via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Claude only sees what your Time Machine account is permitted to access per-user permissions and per-tenant isolation.                                                                                                                                           
  Best for:                                                                                                                                                            
   - L&D and training teams authoring content at scale
   - Sales enablement managers running onboarding and role-play practice                                                                                                
   - Company admins managing users, roles, and content assignments
   - Managers reviewing team learning progress and completion

_published_faq.name: How do I add Time Machine to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Time Machine to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.timeml.ai/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Time Machine MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Time Machine lists 119 MCP tools, including tml_ask_expert, tml_assign_documents_to_expert, tml_assign_roles_to_course, tml_assign_roles_to_expert, tml_assign_user_to_role, tml_create_app_training, tml_create_course, tml_create_demo_training, tml_create_department, tml_create_department_role, tml_create_ile_text_exercise, and tml_create_learning_byte.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Time Machine?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Time Machine in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Time Machine MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Time Machine requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Time Machine is developed by Time Machine. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
